records.reason: Cuts a ritual's gp Cost by 10% (again on a critical primary check). The app casts no rituals and tracks no ritual component spend, so there is no number to change.

Grants a permanent unarmed attack: 1d6, brawling group, agile + finesse + magical. Nothing on the record grants a Strike, so the sheet shows no such attack. The damage type is player-chosen to suit the form (horn/claw/tentacle); a single entry avoids the over-grant of listing every variant as a separate Strike.

fix.note: Damage type follows the form the entity gives you (bludgeoning for a tentacle, piercing for horns, slashing for a claw).

records.reason: An action that coats a weapon so that ONE Strike before your next turn deals +2d6 poison. A one-shot rider from an action taken at the table; nothing persists on the sheet.

A permanent, always-on rider on your own crits: +1d4 persistent poison whenever a critical Strike deals slashing or piercing. It is a conditional damage bonus, which belongs in the situational star registry; nothing carries it today.

situational.when: on a critical hit that deals slashing or piercing damage

records.reason: Lets you roll to find environmental hazards without Searching in exploration mode — an exploration-mode activity the app does not model, with no statistic attached.
Protection from severe cold/heat ENVIRONMENTS after an hour of acclimation. Environmental temperature rules are not modelled and this is not damage resistance or an immunity type the fields accept.
Substitutes drawn sigils for a material component pouch. Spell components are not tracked anywhere in the app and the action cost of Casting a Spell is unchanged.
Grants an extra reaction usable only for implement reactions. The sheet keeps no per-turn action or reaction budget, so there is no counter to raise.
A 2-action burst: enemies save against your already-derived class/spell DC for damage, then a cooldown. Entirely target-side and resolved at the table.

A permanent degree-of-success upgrade on YOUR Diplomacy checks (critical failure becomes failure when Gathering Information or Making an Impression in a settlement). The situational registry already carries exactly this shape (see paragon-benefit-regalia); nothing carries it here.

situational.when: in a settlement, to Gather Information or Make an Impression

records.reason: A permanent 15-foot bane emanation. Bane only imposes a penalty on ENEMIES' attack rolls after they fail a Will save; nothing accrues to your own statistics.

A permanent 15-foot bless emanation. Bless gives YOU (and allies inside) a +1 status bonus to attack rolls, and it is dismissable/self-restoring — a toggleable effect set, i.e. a mode. Nothing delivers the +1 today.

mode.name: Eternal Blessing
mode.duration: permanent — you may Dismiss it, and it returns automatically after 1 minute
mode.note: You are continuously surrounded by bless at a spell rank equal to half your level (rounded up), radius 15 feet (it cannot be increased): you and allies inside gain a +1 status bonus to attack rolls.

records.reason: You are PERMANENTLY quickened — a standing condition on you, not a table ruling. The app keeps no action budget, but RECORD_MARKERS already carries feats that change how a condition works for you (face-your-fears on frightened, uncanny-dodge on off-guard); nothing marks quickened here.

situational.note: Eternal Boost: you are permanently quickened; the extra action can only be used to cast Boost Eidolon or Reinforce Eidolon.

records.reason: You are PERMANENTLY quickened, with the extra action restricted to 1-action composition cantrips. A standing condition on you that nothing on the sheet states.

situational.note: Eternal Composition: you are permanently quickened; the extra action can only be used to cast a 1-action composition cantrip.

records.reason: Makes one qualifying elixir's duration indefinite. The Alchemy panel tracks what you made today, not per-item durations, so no tracked value changes.
An impulse that creates torch-like light sources at range. Light radius and the number of active torches are table props; no character statistic changes.
An ikon whose effect lands entirely on the TARGET (doomed on a critical hit, death when its dying maximum hits 0), plus a transcendence action resolved at the table.

A permanent, player-side interaction with a condition: when you would gain doomed you may roll to avoid it. RECORD_MARKERS is the lane for feats that change how a condition applies to you (face-your-fears already marks frightened); doomed carries no such mark.

situational.note: Evade Doom: when you would gain the doomed condition you can attempt a check; on a success you don't gain it.

records.reason: A 1-action Fly with a 15-foot fly Speed FOR THAT MOVEMENT ONLY (you fall if you end off solid ground). Writing a `speeds` fly entry would be a permanent over-grant.
A free action that grants panache until end of turn while flanked. Panache is already a toggle on the sheet (CLASS_RESOURCES swashbuckler); the trigger is table-side.

While asleep you lose the -4 to AC/Perception/Reflex, are not off-guard, and can act (slowed 2) — a permanent change to how a condition applies to YOU. That is the RECORD_MARKERS lane (uncanny-dodge marks off-guard the same way); the unconscious condition carries nothing.

situational.note: Ever Dreaming: asleep, you take no -4 to AC, Perception and Reflex and are not off-guard; you can act while slowed 2, though still blinded.

records.reason: A reaction that triples the distance of squares in your aura against an incoming ranged attack or a creature's movement — range penalties and movement on the enemy's side, adjudicated at the table.
A 1-action shield Strike that also Raises your Shield on a hit; an action resolved at the table (Raise a Shield already exists as its own toggle).
Adds a humanoid option to your Change Shape. Purely an appearance/form choice with no statistics attached in the printed text.
A reaction that downgrades a TRAP's critical successes and everyone's critical failures against it for 2 rounds — the hazard's side of the table, GM-run.

Automatically Pursue a Lead on anyone you interact with, with no cap. The app models no investigator lead list (only Devise a Stratagem is a tracked resource); the leads themselves are table bookkeeping.
A Strike whose failure does not count toward your multiple attack penalty; MAP is applied by the player during the turn, not stored on the sheet.
A 3-action mythic activity: enemies save against your existing class DC or become frightened, and you and allies get a free Strike/Stride. Target-side plus a table-resolved action.
Upgrades your followers' tier. Followers are ALLY NPC blocks (content.followers is a note-only SimpleCompanion with no derived statistics), so nothing on your own sheet changes.

Raises your exemplar class DC proficiency to expert. Feat-granted class DCs exist only as `classDcGrant` (a flat TRAINED secondary DC in build.ts ~2677) and no lane raises that rank — the same gap already recorded for alchemical-power.

The dedication creates a spirit dwelling that gains a spirit wisp every day (and can be re-primed with a 10-minute ritual); wisps are the currency every other exorcist feat spends. Nothing tracks them. A feat-gated counter in CLASS_RESOURCES (src/rules/classResources.ts) is the right home and no audit field can write it.
Lets Spiral Sworn cost 2 actions to extend its benefit to ALLIES in your spiral's light; your own benefit is unchanged.
Lets the swarm released by Swarm Forth be Huge instead of Large — a battlefield footprint chosen when you use the action, not a sheet statistic.
Changes how a Spellstruck spell's burst/cone/line is laid out on the map. Pure geometry resolved at the table; the Strike and the spell's own numbers are unchanged.

Raises your followers' tier and lets the active follower act without Direct Follower — all of it on an ally NPC (followers are note-only blocks in the Companions tab); your own statistics are untouched.
Caps the Harrowing ritual's primary-check DC and halves/removes its cost. The app runs no rituals and tracks no ritual DC or cost.

A permanent degree-of-success upgrade on YOUR Lore checks to Earn Income (critical failure becomes failure, and double income on a failure at expert). The situational registry carries this exact shape for other crit-fail conversions; nothing carries it here.

situational.when: on a Lore check to Earn Income
situational.bonus: critical failure becomes failure; a failure earns double income if you are an expert in Lore

records.reason: Raises your ADVANCED ALCHEMY LEVEL (3, then 5 at 10th). The app models no advanced-alchemy level cap at all — AlchemyPanel.tsx offers every alchemical item up to your character level, which is always at or above the figure this feat prints — so the feat's raise is not blocked by anything. (Only the item COUNT, `advancedAlchemy`, is modelled.)
